activity.notes: Tribhuwana Wijayatunggadewi (Dyah Gitarja) ruled Majapahit from 1328 to 1350. ATLAS records the conventional reviewed regnal interval rather than extending her Activity through her later life after leaving the throne.

sources.title: Masa Pemerintahan Tribhuwana Wijayatunggadewi Tahun 1328–1350 M — Universitas Negeri Surabaya
sources.citation_text: The historical study treats Tribhuwana Wijayatunggadewi’s Majapahit government as the period 1328–1350 and discusses her accession and rule in that interval.
